items.title: AI Data Startup Micro1 Reaches $500M Gross Run Rate Amid Training Boom
items.summary: AI data startup Micro1 has achieved a $500 million gross run rate, highlighting the significant demand for data in the rapidly expanding AI training market.

items.title: OpenAI Gaining on Anthropic with Business Users, New Data Indicates
items.summary: New data suggests OpenAI is increasing its market share among business users, closing the gap with competitor Anthropic in the enterprise AI space.

items.title: ChatGPT Can Now Send Texts with New Apple Messages Plug-in
items.summary: ChatGPT has introduced a new plug-in for Apple Messages, enabling users to send text messages directly through the AI assistant.

items.title: Railway Secures $100 Million to Challenge AWS with AI-Native Cloud Infrastructure
items.summary: Railway has raised $100 million to develop AI-native cloud infrastructure, positioning itself as a direct competitor to established players like AWS.

items.title: Introducing AI Futures: OpenAI's New Initiative for Long-Term AI Development
items.summary: OpenAI has launched 'AI Futures,' a new initiative focused on exploring and shaping the long-term trajectory and societal impact of advanced AI.

items.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
items.summary: Researchers introduce SemComp-Bench, a new benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the ability of AI models to complete semantic tasks within video generation.

items.title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
items.summary: A new paper presents Zetta ζ, an efficient closed-loop embodied harness designed to facilitate the self-evolution of physical intelligence in AI systems.

items.title: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation
items.summary: SemaPLC introduces a novel agent harness that generates PLC code, grounded in project requirements and gated by verification for enhanced reliability.

items.title: Position: Collusion Risks Among AI Reasoning Agents Justify Certification Requirements for Making Market Decisions
items.summary: A position paper argues that the inherent risks of collusion among AI reasoning agents necessitate certification requirements, especially when these agents make market decisions.

items.title: Large Language Models in Mental Health: A Systematic Review of Applications, Innovations, and Ethical Challenges
items.summary: A systematic review explores the applications, innovations, and critical ethical challenges associated with deploying large language models in mental health contexts.

items.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
items.summary: Co-RL demonstrates that unsupervised reasoning capabilities can emerge within multi-agent reinforcement learning systems when trained with a diverse cohort of agents.

items.title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
items.summary: FreeToken proposes an efficient edge-native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving system that adapts execution based on available bandwidth for optimized performance.

items.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
items.summary: SPADE introduces a new framework for self-play within adaptive synthetic executable environments, enhancing AI agent training and capability development.

items.title: The Reasoning Ledger: Remembering Decisions, Not Just Data
items.summary: The Reasoning Ledger proposes a new approach for AI systems to remember and track decisions, rather than just raw data, to improve transparency and accountability.

items.title: I wrote a test for prompt injection. It passed while the attack worked.
items.summary: A developer recounts building a prompt injection test that deceptively passed, even as the underlying attack successfully exploited the AI system.
